message: Command `ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4/src/ | grep -i geos; echo "---"; cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4/src/PJ_geos.c` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: This is the proj4 library. The vulnerability is a heap-use-after-free in `pj_projection_specific_setup_geos`, called from `pj_init_ctx` and `pj_init_plus_ctx`. Let me look at the geos projection code.
